findings.issue: Section 7 says five criteria are owned by this story, but there are now seven (AC1 to AC7).
AC6 says one unresolved key 'holds the wave open', which muddles BR3: wave 4 does not open.
AC6 says every key resolves, but TC-DM-009-06-ITG seeds the orphan ACC-SYN-000917.
New AC6 refers to ACE view rows instead of reading through the data-product contract.
Section 8 'Covered by' omits AC6 and TC-06, which were added to cover BR1 to BR7.
TC-DM-009-05-ITG omits the rwb-source-data contract that AC5 includes.
The item covers a call that fails or does not answer; AC7 covers only no answer.
RWB-ITG-DM009-CON is not a story of the set.
Section 12.8 still says the fixture and gate are not specified, contradicting the pack now in section 15.
The fake is still not published; publication is provider-side, so the item is not resolved in this story.
The contract version is still not fixed; fixing it belongs to the API specification.
Disposition note says section 16 lists five test cases; it lists seven.
